rows.description: An adult asks whether the choice would make them proud even if nobody clapped and notes their own values before seeking reactions; inner steadiness does not remove the wish for approval but lowers its grip.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child who worked at difficult sums for an hour finds it harder to resist snacks and picks fights; mental fatigue seems to reduce patience, though the science of a single fuel tank is contested.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Skeptic of the fuel tank idea [Observer]
rows.description: A psychology student learns that large replications failed to confirm strong depletion effects and that beliefs about tiredness may matter; tiredness and low motivation are real, but the mechanism is uncertain.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 23–26

rows.description: An adult who made many choices at work orders takeaway and skips the workout; whether the cause is depletion, boredom or shifting priorities, doing hard things earlier and lowering friction helps.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22

rows.description: An adult places the most important task at their best time of day and reduces evening choices by preparing ahead; respecting limits is smarter than blaming character.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22

rows.description: A child sits on their hands and looks away from a sweet to earn two; distraction and thinking of something else help more than raw willpower.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child who has learned that adults often break promises grabs the reward at once; the choice is reasonable when the future is unreliable and not a sign of weak character.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A teenager mutes the game notifications and puts the phone in another room before revising; changing the environment beats gritting teeth.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 18–22

rows.description: A parent or teacher who keeps small promises and shows how to wait through singing or counting builds a child's ability to defer; reliability teaches that waiting pays.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17

rows.description: A teenager decides that if it is after dinner then they open the maths book before the phone; a specific cue and action reduces reliance on in-the-moment choice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22, 23–26
